text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At lunchtime, I went to the cafeteria
and found a rather noisy corner.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Dober~!
Give me a bite of strawberry flavor, please!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: No. You said that last time too and ended up eating my entire portion.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Phew... Phew...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Pearl-san, stop! Stooop!!
My fortune today says "Good luck if sunglasses stay put"!
So please, I beg of you, stoooooop!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...Fukukitaru, let me tell you one thing.
The only one who can stop the rhythm of my heart is me...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Mmm~~~~gh!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: *chomp*... *nibble*... *nibble*...
choice_data_list: ...I'm amazed you can keep eating in a situation like this.
...How can you keep eating in a situation like this?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my~ Dear Trainer.
This task is surprisingly arduous, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Blowing on it like this
makes my mouth so dry, you know~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...As she leisurely munched on her roasted carrot,
Mejiro Bright didn't seem to pay the slightest bit of attention
to the commotion around her.
choice_data_list: You're an Umamusume who can stand firm and composed.
You're an Umamusume who can always stand firm and composed.
Shall I bring you something to drink?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...As she leisurely munched on her roasted carrot,
Mejiro Bright didn't seem to pay the slightest bit of attention
to the commotion around her.
choice_data_list: You're an Umamusume who can stand firm and composed.
You're an Umamusume who can always stand firm and composed.
Shall I bring you something to drink?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Not gentle and laid-back, you say?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Bright! Would you like to share
some strawberry ice cream with Dober and me!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Taiki!
Don't go dragging Bright into this too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Indeed~. I still have carrots left, you see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: So Lady Taiki, if you could please wait until after I have eaten this before calling on me~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Bright-san! Please help me stop Pearl-san's dancing~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Understood~. Then I shall help out
after we finish our meal~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Phew...
...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Phew... Phew...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Is this one of those situations
that's gonna take a really long time!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And as unfazed as ever,
Mejiro Bright spent her lunchtime.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My, thank you very much~!
Then, if I may have some tea...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...*cough, cough*.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Uh, well...
I just choked on my drink, that's all...
choice_data_list: I'll bring something to drink right away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I headed over to the cafeteria's drink bar
and decided to pour a cup of tea for her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking some cold drinks would be nice too,
I prepared some water and returned to the table, only to find—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? That drink you're holding...
could it be...!?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oops!
Bright, you made sure to ask your Trainer
for a drink, didn't you!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa, I brought one too.
I should've asked Bright first.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Fufu, looks like everyone here slipped into their usual habits all at once.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Lined up across Mejiro Bright's desk
was a whole row of drinks
brought over by her friends.
choice_data_list: It seems you're loved by everyone
It looks like everyone really loves you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, rather than being loved,
I believe it is simply that everyone is wonderfully kind~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"However, with this many drinks,
there's no way I could finish them all on my own..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Shall we all have a tea party together now?
Relaxed, cozy, and carefree♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Surrounded by her friends, Mejiro Bright enjoyed not only the meal but also the post-meal teatime completely at her own pace.
